rules.logic: ABIOC(Suspicious identity downloaded multiple objects from a bucket) AND ABIOC(An identity performed a suspicious download of multiple cloud storage objects) — fuses the two auto-tuned mass-download deviations on the same identity and bucket within the run window into a single S3 mass-object-exfiltration incident anchored to the suspicious-identity causality chain.
rules.name: Mass Object Exfiltration — Suspicious-Identity Download Stitch
